cors_fix_verification.root_cause: allow_credentials=True + allow_origins=['*'] violated CORS spec - browsers reject this combination
cors_fix_verification.fix_applied: Set allow_credentials=False in CORSMiddleware (line 1069 of server.py)
cors_fix_verification.why_this_works: App uses Bearer token auth (Authorization header), NOT cookies - credentials flag is not needed
verification_tests: No access-control-allow-credentials header OR value is NOT 'true'
Browser login flow works without network errors

critical_code_review_comments: CORS fix correctly applied - allow_credentials=False in server.py line 1069

All login endpoints properly return tokens and validate credentials

context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS P0 bug is FIXED. The issue was allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] which violates CORS spec. Fix: set allow_credentials=False. This works because the app uses Bearer token auth (Authorization header), not cookies. All auth endpoints verified working.
